name: submit_action
description: Submit your action for this turn. Call it exactly once, after you have finished reasoning.

amount.description: Required for bet and raise: the total you will have committed on this street.

say.description: Optional table talk, shown to every player with your action. At most 70 characters are kept, after the table reduces it to lowercase letters, digits, spaces and . , ! ? - : ;

name: update_scratchpad
description: Replace your private scratchpad with `contents` (at most 5000 characters; longer is cut off). Call it exactly once, only when asked after a hand; during a hand it makes your turn invalid.
